title: Improved bounds on $H_m$ for $2\le m\le 5$
summary: Let $H_m=\liminf_{n\to\infty}(p_{n+m}-p_n)$, where $p_n$ denotes the $n$th prime. We prove \[ H_2\le 20{,}370,\qquad H_3\le 1{,}380{,}156,\qquad H_4\le 82{,}959{,}170,\qquad H_5\le 5{,}040{,}082{,}836, \] improving the bounds $33{,}118$, $2{,}718{,}108$, $214{,}099{,}720$ and $14{,}541{,}349{,}288$ of Roeling (2026). We use the multidimensional Selberg sieve of Maynard and Tao in the form developed by Polymath.
